risk_and_sentiment: Sentiment is cautious to risk-off: 181 positive, 293 negative, and 1257 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
